cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
NM="nmk_live_FtVn4vczCTzAEeZYSQYF65DSwerrKBsPbuAQJx1l"
import subprocess
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()

def call(url,key,model,msgs,mt=300):
    b=json.dumps({"model":model,"messages":msgs,"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request(url,data=b,headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {key}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120) as x: d=json.load(x)
    u=d.get('usage',{}) or {}
    c=u.get('cost') or (d.get('nomask') or {}).get('cost_usd') or 0
    return u.get('prompt_tokens',0),u.get('completion_tokens',0),float(c),u.get('cached_tokens') or (u.get('prompt_tokens_details') or {}).get('cached_tokens',0)

# BEBAN IDENTIK: system prompt gaya LightVela + 1 pertanyaan
sysmsg="You are Hermes, a helpful personal AI agent with long-term memory. "*60
msgs=[{"role":"system","content":sysmsg},{"role":"user","content":"Jelaskan singkat apa itu fotosintesis."}]

print("=== BEBAN IDENTIK (system prompt besar + 1 pertanyaan) ===")
for tag,url,key,model in [
    ("nomask   glm-5.3_flash_uncensored","https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions",NM,"glm-5.3_flash_uncensored"),
    ("obscurify deepseek-v4.1-flash","https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",OB,"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored")]:
    try:
        p,c,cost,ca=call(url,key,model,msgs)
        print(f"{tag:38} prompt={p:5} compl={c:4} cached={ca:5} cost=${cost:.6f}  -> pesan/$1 = {int(1/cost) if cost else 'inf'}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(tag,"HTTP",e.code,e.read().decode()[:100])
